title: agent-workbench event
description: One line of .workbench/events-YYYY-MM.jsonl (append-only). Unknown extra fields are allowed on purpose: the log is written by hooks and read by a dashboard that may be older or newer, so additive changes must not invalidate existing lines. Breaking changes bump `v`.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone offset (or Z).

session_id.description: Provided by the hook. Required for agent_* events.

agent_id.description: Provided by the hook; pairs agent_start with agent_stop. Required (non-null) for agent_start/agent_stop. May be null on agent_error: a failed Agent tool call (e.g. unknown subagent type) never started, so no id exists.

agent.description: Agent name. "orchestrator" for events written on behalf of the main session. Required for agent_* events.

phase.description: Id of the phase that is `doing` in project.yaml when the event was written; if none, the single phase in `review`; otherwise null. Readers may infer a phase for null events (see docs/contract.md).

gate.description: Gate identifier (e.g. dataset-selection, phase-end). Only meaningful on gate/change events; non-null is required on gate_requested and gate_approved.

summary.description: First 200 characters of the response, absolute paths masked. Never the full prompt or response.

rev.description: Short git hash of the project, null when unavailable.

usage.description: Token usage of the subagent run. Only allowed (non-null) on agent_stop; null when extraction failed. Cache tokens are required keys: input_tokens counts only the uncached part of the input, so cost and volume analysis needs all three input fields (input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens).

model.description: Model name as recorded in the transcript; null when it could not be determined.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache.
